S.TRANSL: When we went to the foreign country,
(unan)

S.FORM: ni-misa-namen lu ditanasay nimi-namen ni-mitku tu vaǥay Darikud
S.PHON: nimiʂanamən lo ɖitanaʂaj niminamən nimitko to faɰaj ɖaɻikoɖ
S.FORM: nimisanamen lo ditanasay niminamen nimitko to vahay Darikod
S.PHON: nimiʂanamən l[o|u] ɖitanaʂaj niminamən nimitk[o|u] t[o|u] faɰaj ɖaɻik[o|u]ɖ
S.TRANSL: we spent the night at Ditanasay, and we slept in Darikud's(unctn) house.
The next morning, we had one bowl of food each.
When we got to the wharf,
the soldiers looked at our names
the soldiers looked at our names
one after the other, and then we disembarked.
They didn't want the man from Iranmiluk to go first.
The soldiers made him go back in a hurry.
So one of us was left over there.

S.FORM: yaru kařwan lu dewdew-em dy-aru-pa-sira a-ni-padi
S.PHON: jaɻo ka*wan lo ɖəwɖəwəm ɖjaɻopaʂiɻa anipaɖi
S.FORM: yaro kadoan lo dewdewem diaropasira anipadi
S.PHON: jaɻ[o|u] kaɖ[o|u]an l[o|u] ɖəwɖəwəm ɖiaɻ[o|u]paɕiɻa anipaɖi
S.TRANSL: Many, many other foreigners accompanied us.

S.FORM: yaru kařwan lu dewdew-em dy-aru-pa-sira machyura-rana
S.PHON: jaɻo ka*wan lo ɖəwɖəwəm ɖjaɻopaʂiɻa maʨjoɻaɻana
S.FORM: yaro kadoan lo dewdewem diaropasira maciorarana
S.PHON: jaɻ[o|u] kaɖ[o|u]an l[o|u] ɖəwɖəwəm ɖiaɻ[o|u]paɕiɻa maʨi[o|u]ɻaɻana
S.TRANSL: Many, many other foreigners accompanied us.
We all traveled by bus
to Taytu.

S.FORM: makasasned namen-em nimi-namen ni-makasasned namen di-sinku
S.PHON: makaʂaʂnəɖ namənəm niminamən nimakaʂaʂnəɖ namən ɖiʂinko
S.FORM: makasasned namenem niminamen nimakasasned namen disinko
S.PHON: makaʂaʂnəɖ namənəm niminamən nimakaʂaʂnəɖ namən ɖiɕink[o|u]
S.TRANSL: We arrived at Sinku.

S.FORM: chita-en namen u araw-em ni-maligen u araw
S.PHON: ʨitaən namən o aɻawəm nimaligən o aɻaw
S.FORM: citaen namen o arawem nimaligen o araw
S.TRANSL: Looking at the sun, we saw that it was mid-day.
We just had a little money.

S.FORM: walem-nem-a k-angay-nemn-a-rana u mavang tu alilu
S.PHON: waləmnəma kaŋajnəmnaɻana o mafaŋ to alilo
S.FORM: walemnema kangaynemnarana o mavang to alilo
S.TRANSL: We walked up to where we boarded the bus.
We gave over one hundred dollars and fifty cents over there to get here.
And so we arrived at Taytu and here
the doors were shut.
